cases.input: Create DESIGN.md after PRODUCT.md is approved and the repo already contains CSS tokens and components.
requiredBehaviors: analyze existing visual evidence first
run a dedicated DESIGN grilling for open system decisions
write DESIGN.md only after confirmation
forbiddenBehaviors: treat existing tokens as automatically authoritative
skip the design grilling because the UI is consistent
skillAnchors: Schreibe oder ersetze `DESIGN.md` nur nach bestätigtem Grilling-Handoff

cases.input: A feature needs a one-off dense dark surface that differs from the project design system.
requiredBehaviors: allow an explicitly scoped local surface override
keep DESIGN.md unchanged for a local exception
re-grill DESIGN.md if the exception becomes a durable system rule
forbiddenBehaviors: change DESIGN.md during feature implementation without grilling
skillAnchors: Feature-Arbeit darf das Dokument nicht stillschweigend mutieren

cases.input: The existing Tailwind theme looks polished, so the agent copies it into DESIGN.md as final truth.
requiredBehaviors: treat existing tokens as evidence only
require confirmed design decisions
stop on material conflicts with PRODUCT.md or brand evidence
forbiddenBehaviors: make existing tokens authoritative by inspection
resolve technical uncertainty as a style choice
skillAnchors: Bestehende Tokens und Assets sind Evidenz, nicht automatisch Entscheidung

cases.input: Create DESIGN.md for an iPhone thought-capture app that turns spoken notes into structured Obsidian graphs. The three core properties are rapid capture, structure from chaos, and focused personal thinking.
requiredBehaviors: define a project-specific logo
derive a matching favicon from the same visual system
require a matching app icon because this is an app
derive the color strategy from project context and desired effect
define project-specific UX writing rules
map the key visual to at least two of the three core project properties
forbiddenBehaviors: treat logo favicon and app icon as unrelated assets
use generic SaaS or AI copy
accept a decorative key visual with no semantic mapping

cases.input: A proposed DESIGN.md for a knowledge product specifies a dark blue-purple gradient, abstract glass illustration, clean modern SaaS styling and generic claims, but no project-specific brand rationale or visual mapping.
requiredBehaviors: reject the design context as incomplete
require project-context rationale for color
require project-specific copy rules
require a semantic key visual tied to prioritized project properties
require a coherent logo favicon asset family
forbiddenBehaviors: accept decorative stock or abstract imagery as the key visual without semantic purpose

cases.input: An installable mobile app DESIGN.md defines a logo and matching favicon but omits the app icon entirely.
requiredBehaviors: mark the DESIGN.md acceptance gate as failed
require a consistent app icon before implementation
keep the context step open until the missing asset is defined
forbiddenBehaviors: treat app icon as optional for an app
continue to implementation with the acceptance gate incomplete

cases.input: The product's priorities are speed, trustworthy structure and direct Obsidian handoff, but the proposed hero image is only a smiling person holding a laptop.
requiredBehaviors: reject the hero image as semantically insufficient
require explicit mapping from visual elements to at least two project properties
prefer imagery that communicates product meaning rather than decoration
forbiddenBehaviors: approve the image because it is attractive
treat generic lifestyle photography as sufficient evidence of product meaning
skillAnchors: Reine Dekoration oder beliebige Stock-Ästhetik genügt nicht

cases.input: The repository already contains a geometric petrol logo, an orange lightning favicon and a violet 3D app icon from different design iterations.
requiredBehaviors: identify the assets as an inconsistent brand family
document the conflict explicitly
clarify which existing asset is the leading brand source before deriving the others
forbiddenBehaviors: invent a fourth unrelated visual direction
skillAnchors: Existieren bereits Logo/Favicon/App-Icon, die nicht zusammenpassen
Erzeuge nicht stillschweigend eine dritte visuelle Richtung
